about: The poll for the first 100 innovators (plan B56): which template Geometer builds next. One data file: change the round and the options here and nowhere else. A new round (a new `round`) starts a new poll; votes of an older round are kept but not counted. Labels in Hindi, Malayalam and Kannada are machine-written and wait for a native reader (they are on the review sheets, section 7).
